lead: The landscape of artificial intelligence continues to evolve, with significant developments in governance, legal implications, and industry shifts.

stories.title: AI Without Governance Is Just Expensive Risk
stories.summary: A recent analysis highlights that many organizations lack a coherent AI strategy, leading to potential risks. Without proper governance, the investments in AI may not yield the expected returns, raising concerns about accountability and ethical use of technology.

stories.title: OpenAI wants California to strengthen its newly passed AI safety law
stories.summary: OpenAI is advocating for enhancements to California's AI safety legislation, SB 53, which it initially supported. The company emphasizes the need for stronger safeguards to mitigate risks associated with advanced AI technologies.

stories.title: Nvidia customers notified about AI-related price hikes
stories.summary: Nvidia has informed its customers that prices for AI-related servers will increase by over 15% due to rising memory costs. This price hike reflects the increasing demand and competition in the AI hardware market.

stories.title: Employers are quietly rehiring the people AI replaced, and paying them less to come back
stories.summary: A report reveals that many employers regret layoffs made in the name of AI efficiency and are beginning to rehire staff at lower wages. This trend raises questions about the long-term impact of AI on employment and worker trust.

stories.title: A lawsuit says Oura’s sleep stages are AI guesses with a coin flip’s odds
stories.summary: A class action lawsuit claims that the Oura ring's sleep tracking is based on unreliable AI estimates rather than accurate measurements. This raises concerns about the validity of consumer health technologies that rely on AI.

stories.title: A free AI model is winning over developers. And nobody knows whose servers it runs on
stories.summary: A mysterious AI model named Ox Alpha has surfaced on OpenRouter, gaining popularity among developers despite its anonymous nature. This raises questions about accountability and transparency in the AI development space.

stories.title: Twitch and Amazon hit with lawsuit for training AI with streamers' content
stories.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Twitch and Amazon, alleging that the companies used streamers' content to train their AI models without consent. This case highlights the legal complexities surrounding AI training datasets.

stories.title: ‘We are hitting a different chapter’: OpenAI leader warns of threat of ‘persistent’ AI cyber-attacks
stories.summary: OpenAI's chief global affairs officer warns of an emerging threat from AI-driven cyber-attacks, urging the need for new safety standards. As AI capabilities advance, the potential for malicious use becomes a pressing concern.
